title: laravel-env v1.19.0: redirect-path-semantics
value:
`--redirect-to` is always an origin; `--redirect-path keep` (the default)
sends the path and query along, `drop` sends every request to `/`.

title: laravel-env v1.19.0: redirect-persistence
value:
`keep` remains the default. The mode is stored with the site, survives
certificate installs and other re-renders, and is shown by
`site redirect-list`. Redirect sites created before 1.19.0 keep their path.
